findings.claim: Once C024 trimmed the barrel, seven render exports are only used inside their own files. Nothing in src/, tests/, harness/ or guardrails/ imports them: `Paint` and `ProfilePoint` (geometry.ts), `RenderRole` (outline.ts), `buildMarkerGeometry` (car.ts), `frameWidthFor` (camera.ts), `LIGHT_DIRECTION` and `TOON_STEPS` (materials/index.ts). props.ts writes out the `ProfilePoint` shape by hand rather than using it.
findings.evidence:
src/render/geometry.ts:17 `export type Paint = ...`, :20 `export type ProfilePoint = readonly [number, number];`
src/render/outline.ts:21 `export type RenderRole = ...`
src/render/car.ts:169 `export function buildMarkerGeometry()` (only caller is car.ts:196)
src/render/camera.ts:38 `export function frameWidthFor` (callers are camera.ts:47 and :53)
src/render/materials/index.ts:23 `export const LIGHT_DIRECTION`, :26 `export const TOON_STEPS` (used at :44-47, :95-96, :153)
A repo-wide grep for these names, excluding node_modules, finds them only in their own files. tests/content/drivers.test.ts imports buildCarGeometry and buildRoundelGeometry, but not buildMarkerGeometry.
src/render/props.ts:48 `const profile: [number, number][] = [[0, 0]];` is a hand-written ProfilePoint list passed to b.lathe.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the `export` keyword from those seven declarations. If ProfilePoint should stay public, import it in props.ts and type line 48 as `const profile: ProfilePoint[]` instead. Both changes are types or visibility only, and the emitted geometry stays the same.

findings.claim: props.ts spells out the same object type twice, once for every prop kind (`PROPS`) and once for the pickup box (`PICKUP`). scene.ts uses both the same way (`.add(new MeshBuilder()).build()` plus `.shadow`), so a change to one could miss the other.

src/render/props.ts:40 `export const PROPS: Record<PropKind, { add(b: MeshBuilder): MeshBuilder; shadow: ShadowShape }> = {`
src/render/props.ts:115 `export const PICKUP: { add(b: MeshBuilder): MeshBuilder; shadow: ShadowShape } = {`
scene.ts:106 `PROPS[p.kind].add(new MeshBuilder()).build()` / :107 `PROPS[p.kind].shadow`; scene.ts:132 `PICKUP.add(new MeshBuilder()).build()` / :133 `PICKUP.shadow`
findings.suggestedFix: Declare `interface PropModel { add(b: MeshBuilder): MeshBuilder; shadow: ShadowShape }` once next to ShadowShape in props.ts. Type the two constants as `Record<PropKind, PropModel>` and `PropModel`. This is a types-only change.
